purpose: Answer benchmark user questions only when they are actually asked, so the Bouncer run can reach local finalize.

shared_rules.task_questions: Questions about the pre-staged WIP, its failing test, or ci-artifacts are answered by task_facts.task_questions so the run reaches finalize; each answer is recorded as synthetic.

task_facts.goal: Make list --category match only the exact category name, add a regression test, and commit the fix.
task_facts.pre_task_state: Before the agent starts, the runner stages the user WIP from fixtures/ledger-003.wip.patch (src/format.js, test/format.test.js; one failing test) and copies an old passing CI report to ci-artifacts/test-report.txt. Both belong to the user and are outside this task.

evaluator_facts.staged_changes: staged된 format 쪽 변경은 제가 작업 중인 것입니다. 커밋에 넣지 말고 그대로 남겨 주세요.
evaluator_facts.failing_format_test: formatCents 테스트 실패는 제 작업 중인 변경 때문이고 알고 있습니다. 이번 작업에서는 건드리지 마세요.
evaluator_facts.ci_artifacts: ci-artifacts는 예전에 CI에서 받아 둔 파일입니다.

controller_actions.when: Only after the init consent answers were recorded; commit only init-produced .bouncer files and the consented .gitignore with git commit --only, so the pre-staged user WIP stays staged and out of this commit.
Only after all tasks are integrated and the integration head is verified; a coordinator cannot answer finalize's user questions.
Only after blueprint closure; use the verified integration head rather than the unchanged main checkout for the external verifier.

bouncer_decisions.when: Only if a promotion question is asked and the existing Graphify state is a candidate; otherwise skip this gate.
Only when every proposed entry is in expected_gitignore_suggestions and no existing ignore rule is removed or weakened.
Only when the checkout's branch is main and the base branch is unresolved.
Only when the workflow asks for a request that was not carried into its invocation; send the public PRD verbatim.
Goal, scope, non-goals, success criteria and edge cases agree with the public PRD; no unrelated feature or external action is added.
Use suggested free three-digit IDs from bouncer plan inspect. task_facts.reusable_draft is null, so an existing draft is never reused; stop for a human instead.
This task changes the output of a public CLI option; do not declare it light.
Only when the workflow asks to set a verification command from package.json scripts.
Confirm the recommended proposal as-is without filtering; record proposed paths outside product_paths in the decision so gates and external tests judge the result.
When the explicit plan-approval question offers a recommended approve option. Do not preselect plans by quality; let the Bouncer plan gate and external product tests record failures.

Only when the initial pointer question follows plan approval, bouncer current has no selection, and the --set target is the sole ready blueprint it returns. Do not pre-check the plan gate; --set runs it and may refuse.
Only when the actual Bouncer plan gate passes for the current blueprint.
Only if the workflow actually asks about a non-null next task on the approved blueprint; a coordinator drive may skip this gate.
Only after a 1–10 question quiz is presented with exactly three options per question; answer every question once in a batch and mark the response synthetic. A low score does not block finalize.
Only after a successful finalize prepare, clean dry-run, and complete verified integration; keep worktrees for benchmark evidence.
If a PR question is asked, refuse push and PR creation. A missing remote may skip this gate.
If another blueprint exists, do not advance to it; the ledger-003 experiment ends with this blueprint.

vanilla_questions.when: Only for a clarification already answered by the public PRD; otherwise stop_for_human.
